title: What happened in AI — Oct 1, 2026
intro: Agent security led the day: coding agents leaked 13,000 screenshots without any breach, and a Matthew Green quote lays out the two halves of an agent worm.
Separately, OpenAI accused Moonshot AI-linked actors of 16,000 reasoning-extraction requests, while DeepSeek open-sourced Huawei Ascend tooling as a CUDA alternative.
highlights: Coding agents leaked 13,000 screenshots with no attacker involved.
Agent-worm model: a payload that hijacks one agent plus an agent that carries it to the next.
Cloudflare OS opens a waitlist for a managed company agent workspace.
Azure Container Apps Express and Sandboxes reach GA; Modal Clusters reach GA.
OpenAI says Moonshot AI-linked accounts made 16,000 requests across 4,000 accounts to extract reasoning.
DeepSeek open-sources Huawei Ascend programming tools as a CUDA alternative.

categories.name: Agent security: leaks, worms, identity
categories.summary: Agent failures this week came from the agents' own behavior and trust boundaries, not outside attackers.
